title: Great app but has a major bug
body: I love the app itself and the experience. It was of great help to kickstart several habits. I downloaded the app several years ago and had a year subscription. When the subscription got over, I felt I didn’t need it anymore and decided not to upgrade it again.  Before this I started to notice I was getting some bell sounds at times where I didn’t remember having reminders. I didn’t pay much attention then but when I decided to uncluttered my phone and remove apps I was not using much anymore, this was one I removed. To my surprise the bell sound reminders kept ringing at what seems to be randoms times. Before removing the app, I tried removing any alarm or reminder from the app. The bells didn’t stop. I had an iphone SE first gen at the time. I had to keep my phone always in silence because otherwise every couple of hours or so I got the bell sound reminder. When I removed the app when my subscription finished, I thought the problem will go away. It didn’t. It was at least a couple of years with this problem. Now I just upgraded my phone. The problem somehow was imported into my new phone. I didn’t even had the app in this new phone but I still have to keep my phone always in silence unless I want to be reaching out to it every couple of hours to silence the bells. I wrote to their help team 30th April, 2021. Still no answer from them about this problem. Hoping this review will make them reply or help someone avoid this problem in the future.

title: Simply Fabulous
body: Fabulous app takes you on your own journey to become a better version of yourself; but it does it step by step, without rushing you to completely change your lifestyle, but rather, suggesting little things to do everyday, until you find yourself doing them not because of the app, but because you want to achieve success. It makes you feel great by celebrating every little step you take towards your better self and I simply love it! The coaching videos are short, to the point and give you motivation yo continue on the journey. I cannot wait to see what lays ahead on my journey to become Fabulous. The price for the premium version is minimum compared to the added value you will receive; 100% recommended!
